scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c teal,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build -w client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist','dist',{recursive:true}); console.log('Vercel output:', fs.readdirSync('dist').join(', '));"
